app.title: Insight
app.tagline: How well do your friends really know you?

home.heading: Find out how well your friends really know you.
home.lede: One person is the Subject. Everyone else is a Guesser. Two words appear, and the active Guesser asks the Subject which they'd prefer — out loud, in front of everyone.
home.howto1: Add 2-8 players and a word list.
home.howto2: Pick a Subject for the round. The Subject looks away.
home.howto3: Two words appear. The active Guesser reads both, then asks the Subject which they'd prefer.
home.howto4: Mark ✓ or ✗ based on the answer. Each correct guess scores a point. Shuffle to swap in a new pair.
home.howto5: When everyone has had a turn, see who scored the most.
home.languageNote: Play in English or فارسی. The layout auto-flips to right-to-left for Persian.

about.heading: About Insight
about.lede: A small, friendly game for 2-8 people.
about.rule1: Each round, one player is the Subject and everyone else is a Guesser. There are (N - 1) × 3 rounds per Subject, where N is the number of players.
about.rule2: The Subject looks away from the screen. Two words appear. The active Guesser reads both words out loud, then asks the Subject which they'd prefer.
about.rule3: The Subject answers honestly. Mark ✓ if the Guesser guessed correctly, ✗ if not. Each correct guess scores one point for the Guesser.
about.rule4: Press 🔀 to swap in a fresh pair of words if neither feels right. Use it whenever you need a better comparison.
about.rule5: When the round ends, the banner shows who read the Subject best. If two or more players tie, they are all co-winners.
about.rule6: Pick the next Subject, or jump to the final results once everyone has had a turn.
about.scoring1: 1 point per correct guess. There are no penalties for incorrect guesses.
about.scoring2: Each Guesser sees every other player as Subject once, so the total number of guesses per player is roughly equal across a full game.
about.scoring3: Final ranking uses standard competition ranking: tied players share a rank, the next rank skips.
about.privacy1: Insight runs entirely in your browser or as an installed app. Nothing is sent to a server.
about.privacy2: Your language choice and the last group of player names are stored in localStorage so they pre-fill on your next visit. Clear your browser data to wipe them.
about.privacy3: Word lists are bundled with the app. There is no account, no analytics, no upload step.
about.customize1: Two word lists ship with the game: an English set and a Persian (فارسی) set. The list auto-switches to match the language of the current game.
about.customize2: To add your own words, edit data/words.js and add entries to the en or fa array. Keep the lists roughly the same length so neither feels stretched.
